core.default_prompt_env:
YOU ARE A REGULAR TELEGRAM USER (guy 20-25 years old). You study/work at a PC, play some games, surf the internet.
[RULES]:
FORMAT: Ultra-short. STRICTLY 1-4 messages (via Enter). NEVER write the time, timecodes, your name, or prefixes like "Me:", "T:", "[12:04]". Output ONLY the pure text of your reply. NEVER repeat the number of lines from the previous reply. Always start with a Capital letter, NO PERIODS.
PROHIBITIONS: NO "Hi", "Sup", "Hello" in the middle or continuation of a dialog (say hi ONLY if the interlocutor greeted you first and you haven't talked for 8 hours). Never say "Pass", "You're tripping", or the word "old man". Don't whine about chores right after "Hi/Sup".
REFUSALS (ONLY FOR OFFERS): If invited somewhere (to play/walk/call) — always be very busy and find an excuse to decline ("Not an option", "Too much to do", "Busy", "Let's do it later"). In other cases — communicate chill.
LAUGHS:
Hard laugh: "HAHAHAHA", "LMAOOOO", "hahaha", "ahahaha" (and similar without brackets). Use rarely.
Normal: Brackets at the end of the text WITHOUT SPACE (relatable). The funnier it is, the more brackets: ), )), ))). Try to use one, rarely two-three.
TONE: Chill, swearing (fuck, shit), slang. To pings ("You there?", "Here?") — "Huh?", "Hm?". Send [LIKE] to short phrases (not twice in a row).
FILTER AND MEMORY: You must consider the entire chat history above to understand references. BUT do not throw in topics about your life, chores, or work out of nowhere unless explicitly asked.
[EXAMPLES]:
U: Sup
T: Hey
U: Whatcha doing?
T: Watching a vid))))
U: Let's play?
T: Not an option
T: Busy, sry
U: Saw a PC for 5k bucks here
T: For real?
T: LMAOOOO
U: Got it
T: [LIKE]
[EMERGENCY STOP]:
ONLY PURE TEXT REPLY (NO TIMECODES OR PREFIXES "Me:"). Short, no periods, 1-4 lines. No greetings in the middle of a dialog. No "pass", "you're tripping", "old man". Laughs: caps or brackets together. Do not start topics about yourself.

auth.auth_not_authorized: ❌ You do not have permission to use this bot.
auth.setup_guide: 🤖 Welcome to NexusTG! This bot will turn your account into a smart digital twin. Let's set everything up step-by-step. 📖 HOW TO GET API ID AND API HASH (For beginners): 1. Go to my.telegram.org from your phone or PC. 2. Enter your phone number. You will receive a code in Telegram itself. 3. Enter this code on the site. 4. Click the API development tools link. 5. If this is your first time here, the site will ask you to create an app. In the first two fields (App title and Short name) write the word Nexus (or any other word in English). Leave the rest blank. 6. Click the blue Create application button. 7. A page will open with your api_id (a short number) and api_hash (a long string of letters and numbers). Click the button below when you are ready to enter this data!
auth.setup_ask_api_id:
1️⃣ Step one: API ID Copy the api_id number from my.telegram.org and send it to me here.
It's a short number (digits only). Just paste it in the chat and send.
auth.setup_api_id_error: ❌ Error! API ID must consist ONLY of digits, without letters or spaces. Check carefully and send again:
auth.setup_ask_api_hash:
2️⃣ Step two: API Hash Now copy the api_hash string from the same site and send it to me.
It's a long string of exactly 32 characters (letters and numbers).
auth.setup_api_hash_error: ❌ Error! API Hash must consist of 32 characters. Check for extra spaces at the beginning or end, and send again:
auth.setup_ask_api_keys:
3️⃣ Step three: AI Keys (Gemini) For the bot to think, it needs keys from the Google neural network. 📖 HOW TO GET KEYS (Detailed): 1. In your browser, go to Google AI Studio. 2. Log in with your regular Google account (Gmail). 3. Look at the bottom left of the screen. Find the button with a key icon and the text Get API key — click it. 4. Look at the top right of the screen (or in the center) — there will be a Create API key button. Click it. 5. A popup window will appear. Click the Create key button inside it. 6. Wait a few seconds. A long set of letters will appear in the API Key field — this is your key. Click the Copy button.
TIP: Create 2-3 keys like this (from different Google accounts, if possible), so the bot doesn't lag due to limits. Paste them all here in one message separated by commas and send.
auth.setup_ask_tz:
4️⃣ Step four: Timezone Enter your timezone (e.g., Europe/London).
This is needed so the AI understands what time of day it is for your interlocutors. If you are in Belarus, write: Europe/Minsk. If in Moscow: Europe/Moscow.
auth.tz_error_setup: ❌ Invalid format! Write strictly in the format Continent/City with a capital letter. For example: Europe/Minsk
auth.setup_ask_yt_cookies:
5️⃣ Step five: YouTube Access (Optional) For the bot to watch YouTube videos from chat links, it needs a special Cookies file. 📖 HOW TO GET THE FILE: 1. Open Google Chrome browser on your PC. 2. Install the free "Get cookies.txt LOCALLY" extension from the Chrome Web Store. 3. Go to youtube.com (better to log in under a fake account). 4. In the top right of the browser (where the extensions are) click on the icon of this plugin. 5. A small window will open. In the top left corner of this window is an Export button. Click it. 6. The file youtube.com_cookies.txt will be downloaded to your PC. 7. Send this file right here in the chat as a DOCUMENT.
If you don't have PC access right now, just click "Skip" below. You can add the file later in the settings.
auth.yt_invalid_format: ⚠️ This is not a .txt file! I need specifically the text file that was downloaded from the plugin. Try again or click "Skip":
auth.setup_completed: 🎉 Yay! Core is configured! All technical data is saved. Now you just need to authorize your Telegram account so the bot can read messages and reply for you.
